## Reviso review — detached HEAD (1950a51102) vs b8c1cd410f4499c77a8b372decfe1718b80ccfd2 (1 commit, 10 files)
Base: b8c1cd410f4499c77a8b372decfe1718b80ccfd2 via flag — merge-base b7b84d75d1

Found 2 issues:

1. [P1][conf 95] All-clients view grants bypass client-specific denies — services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/ClientPermissionsV2.java:87
   Failure: Grant VIEW for all clients and deny VIEW for one client. Both direct retrieval and listing still expose that client because global canView() bypasses its permission evaluation.
   Fix: Reserve unconditional visibility for admin roles, evaluate fine-grained visibility per client, and separately authorize entry to the list endpoint.
   (bugs)

2. [P2][conf 95] Manage permission cannot list the client scopes it authorizes — services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/ClientPermissionsV2.java:121
   Failure: Grant only MANAGE for all clients. Individual client scopes can be read and managed, but listing scopes returns 403 without QUERY_CLIENTS, or an empty list with that role.
   Fix: Override canListClientScopes() and canViewClientScopes() to recognize the all-clients MANAGE grant alongside VIEW.
   (bugs)

Checked: bugs, conventions, comments, slop, deterministic.
Not checked: history (no result: historical patch blobs are missing from the partial clone and unavailable offline).
Skipped: nothing.

findings.title: All-clients view grants bypass client-specific denies
findings.failure_scenario: Grant an administrator VIEW on all Clients, then attach a denying VIEW permission to one client. The administrator can still retrieve and list that client because the global grant bypasses client-specific evaluation.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep unconditional canView() limited to admin roles, evaluate fine-grained VIEW per client in canView(ClientModel), and separately allow list access for administrators with an all-clients VIEW grant so ClientsResource filters each result.
findings.evidence: ClientPermissionsV2.java:87 treats the all-clients VIEW grant as unconditional visibility; ClientPermissionsV2.java:78 and ClientsResource.java:148 consequently skip client-specific evaluation. UserResourceTypeEvaluationTest.java:203 demonstrates the existing contract that an object-specific deny overrides an all-resource VIEW grant.

findings.title: Manage permission cannot list the client scopes it authorizes
findings.failure_scenario: An administrator with only an all-clients MANAGE grant can create, update, and directly read client scopes, but GET /client-scopes returns 403 without QUERY_CLIENTS. Adding QUERY_CLIENTS allows the request but still yields an empty list.
findings.suggested_fix: Override canListClientScopes() and canViewClientScopes() in ClientPermissionsV2 to accept all-clients MANAGE as well as VIEW, while preserving the existing admin-role checks.
findings.evidence: ClientPermissionsV2.java:109 and :121 recognize MANAGE for managing and reading individual client scopes, but :87 recognizes only VIEW for global visibility. Inherited ClientPermissions.java:259 and :490 use that global visibility result, and ClientScopesResource.java:91 gates listing before :93 returns an empty stream when it is false.
